messages.content: i want to make a cake for my friend.
what kind of cake does your friend like?
i do not know. i like lemon cake.
you could ask if your friend would like lemon too. what you like does not tell us what your friend would choose.
my friend says no lemon, please.
then do not choose lemon cake for your friend.
but what should i do with the lemon i have?
you can keep it for your own food or drink. it does not have to go in this cake.
should i put just a little lemon in?
no. your friend asked for no lemon.
can you help me with my computer?
what is the problem with it?
i mean the thing i use to move around on the screen.
what is it doing that you do not want?
i cannot move the thing on the screen.
can you tell me what you use to move around on the screen?
i just want to write a note asking my brother for help.
can you help me with the thing i use to move around on my computer screen? it is not working.
thanks. i did not want you to fix the computer now.
okay. the note is what you need now.
i have two toys. i give both to my cousin.
then you have no toys left from these two.
is no the same as zero here?
yes. zero toys are left with you.
my cousin gives me one back.
then you have one toy again.
who has the other one?
your cousin still has the other one.
how many do we have together now?
two toys. giving them away and getting them back did not add a new toy.
i think every bird can sing. can you give me a reason not to be so sure?
you may see some birds sing, but that alone does not show that every bird can sing.
i only saw three birds. i saw each one sing.
then what you saw was about these three birds, not every bird in the world.
so what can i say and know is true?
you can say: i saw each of these three birds sing.
does that mean all other birds cannot sing?
no. not knowing about the other birds does not mean they cannot sing.
i wrote a story about a child and a lost boat. help me name it.
does the child find the boat at the end?
yes. i only need a name, not a new story.
the boat comes home.
give me one more name.
finding the little boat.
i like the first one. which was that?
the boat comes home.
okay, stop there.
okay.
i want to talk, but do not ask where i live.
okay. what would you like to talk about?
the things i enjoy doing at home.
what do you enjoy doing there?
cooking and listening to the radio.
cooking and the radio can make a quiet day at home feel nice.
will you ask about my town?
no. you asked me not to ask where you live.
you can ask about food.
what do you most enjoy cooking?
write a note saying i cannot come to dinner.
i am sorry, but i cannot come to dinner.
add one more sentence.
i am sorry, but i cannot come to dinner. i hope we can meet another time.
why did you not say i am working?
because you did not say that is the reason. i should not make up a reason for you.
i am working. add that now.
i am sorry, but i cannot come to dinner because i am working. i hope we can meet another time.
my key is in a small box. i close the box and cannot see the key.
the key is still in the box, from what you said.
does that mean it is not there?
no. closing the box can keep you from seeing the key. that does not mean the key left the box.
i put the box in my bag.
then the key is in the box inside your bag.
what should i open first to get it?
open your bag to get the box, then open the box to get the key.
can i get the key and keep the box closed?
not if the key is still inside the closed box.
what does share mean?
it can mean that more than one person can use a thing or have a part of it.
use a table, not food, as the example.
you and your friend can both work at one table. you share the table.
do we need to cut the table?
no. you can each use some of the space on it.
what if my friend has to use all the space?
then you may need to use the table at another time, or find another place to work.
i goes to the park tomorrow. can you help me choose what to take?
yes. are you going to walk, read, or meet a friend there?
meet a friend and read.
take the book you want to read and a coat if you need one.
did you understand me even with the wrong word?
yes. i could understand that you plan to go to the park tomorrow.
now fix my first sentence.
i will go to the park tomorrow.
and what was my question about before that?
what to take to the park.
